charter.title: What lyrid keeps
charter.lede: The sky is public and works without an account. An account remembers what is listed below across your machines, and this page is the whole list — not a summary of one.

noAccount.heading: If you have no account
noAccount.body: Nothing about you is stored on the server. Your marker's shape and colour live in your own browser, and the view you are looking at lives in the address bar. Neither reaches us.

withAccount.heading: If you do
withAccount.addressBody: To sign you in, and to send you a way back if you lose your password. Two letters, ever: one to confirm the address, one to reset a password. No announcements, no newsletter.
withAccount.place: Where you left the sky, and how you like your marked star drawn.
withAccount.placeBody: The reason an account is worth having.
withAccount.sessionsBody: A random token per browser, so signing out actually ends the session rather than waiting for it to expire.
withAccount.listening: If you link ListenBrainz: its account name, and every listen from then on.
withAccount.listeningBody: For each listen, when it was, which artists it was by (their MusicBrainz ids), how long it ran and the light it gathered — no track or album names. Your listens are already public on ListenBrainz; this copy exists only so your own sky can show what you have heard. The token you paste to link is checked once and never kept. Unlinking stops the reading; what was gathered stays until you delete the account.

counted.heading: What is counted, and what is not
counted.body: How often each part of lyrid gets used is counted — how many times the radio was opened on a given day, not who opened it. The counters are numbers that go up. There is no row per event, so there is nothing to join back to a person, and no clever query later can turn these into a history of what you looked at.
counted.never: What lyrid does not do: use your listening for anything but your own sky, sell or share anything with anyone, run third-party analytics or advertising, or track you across other sites.

whose.heading: Whose sky is it
whose.body: The map itself is built from open data — MusicBrainz, ListenBrainz, Discogs, Wikidata and Wikipedia — and belongs to nobody. Your account holds no part of it.

controls.heading: Your data, in your hands
controls.signedOut: Sign in to take your data back or destroy it.

controls.deleteFailed: the account could not be deleted
controls.confirmBody: This removes the account, the profile, every session and all your listening, right now. It cannot be undone and there is no copy to restore from — download your data first if you want it.

listening.heading: Listening
listening.pitch: What you listen to anywhere opens its stars here and gathers light.
listening.linkBody: Whatever you play that scrobbles to ListenBrainz opens its stars here and gathers light — new music far more than old favourites. Reading starts from the moment you link.
listening.tokenWhere: your user token is on the ListenBrainz settings page
listening.tokenKept: The token only proves the account is yours: lyrid checks it once and does not keep it.

listening.unlinkBody: lyrid stops reading your listening. What it has already opened and gathered stays with your account, and goes only when the account does.
